document_rules.statement: FVG = 3-candle imbalance (c1 high < c3 low bullish, mirrored bearish); trade retrace-fill; SL beyond FVG; target next liquidity; FVG INVALID once filled; HTF FVG > LTF
FVG continuation: bottoming -> impulse leaves 5m FVG -> BODY close above confirms -> retrace-fill entry -> target next bearish OB; London 08:00 / NY 13:30 UTC; R:R 1:3
BPR = overlap of opposing FVGs; entry at overlap; SL beyond swing; BPR + reversal candle = A+++

OB = last opposing candle before impulse; liquidity: equal H/L, swing H/L, Asia H/L, PDH/PDL, round numbers; sweep = wick-through + close-back-inside -> reversal-candle entry; SL beyond OB body/sweep wick
Asia fakeout trap: push to Asia high, wick through but NO BODY CLOSE above, then lower low = trap confirmed; short retracement; SL above failed high; works mirrored; London/NY opens
document_rules.status: OBSERVED; documented logic behind the Asia-trap alerts

document_rules.statement: GRADE TABLE: C=lone pattern skip; B=FVG-only or pattern at S/R watch; A=FVG+pattern at FVG; A+=BPR+pattern+trend; A+++=BPR+OB+sweep+reversal+trend / Asia-fakeout+LL+engulfing / bottom+FVG+close-above+claim->OB

document_rules.statement: Engulfing: body fully covers prior body AND >=2x its size; entry next-candle open; SL beyond engulfing wick; after liquidity sweep = A+++
BE at +50 pips (=$5; 1 pip = $0.10 on XAU per p5) - move SL to entry; worked example 4500->4505->SL 4500
Layering (LP): add position in drawdown (example -150 pips); both BE at mid-level (4492.50 example)
Signal anatomy (pair/direction/entry-zone/SL/TP1-2-3) + 'Enter as soon as the signal is published when you can'
Tranche schedules: Conservative 50/30/20; Advanced 30/30 + move SL to entry (+50) + leave remainder running
SL placement: find key S/R -> place beyond -> check risk -> adjust size -> NEVER move further away; never remove or widen
3-Point Entry: three layered entries, ONE shared stop, BE at +50 pips FROM AVERAGE, never add a 4th entry to a loser (example 4500/4490/4480 avg 4490 SL 4460)
Pattern definitions: Doji open~close; Gravestone/Dragonfly; Hammer/Shooting Star wick >=2x body; Morning/Evening Star 3rd candle closes past midpoint of candle 1; Tweezers matching highs/lows
Golden rules: patterns are confirmation not standalone; context (S/R) > pattern; HTF > LTF; wait for candle close; pattern in the middle of nowhere = noise
